name: avista-design-systems
description: Fetch the org's Claude Design design systems — including the view-only ones that DesignSync's list_projects hides — and brand documents with them. Discovery is live: every run probes candidate project ids with get_project and lists only what actually resolves, so read-only systems shared by a teammate are usable by id even though they never appear in list_projects. Reads each system's own tokens and logo, then renders a client-ready PDF through headless Chrome so the system's web fonts are embedded properly.
